title: Pass 1F: revise interpreter per Pass 1R (Opus)
description:
Reviewer REQUEST CHANGES. Three must-fix issues:

(a) Finding 17 — step! exception-safety: snapshot pushed BEFORE forward(); if forward() throws, history corrupted. Wrap forward() in try; on exception, pop the snapshot, rethrow. Or reorder: compute new_state first, then push snapshot, then assign s.current.

(b) Finding 5 — unrun!: load-bearing P0.6 invariant 'isempty(s.history) after unrun!' is only documented, not asserted in code body. Add @assert isempty(s.history) "unrun! postcondition violated" after the while-loop.

(c) Finding 19 — Interpreter.jl Q2.3 docstring claims ':error transitions never push' but code only pops when status-flip is pure (no pc/locals change). Either:
   (i) align code to docstring: always pop on :error regardless of side effects (simpler, makes :error semantically identical to :halted with no observable side effects — and forces side-effecting :error to be a category error)
   (ii) align docstring to code: rewrite Q2.3 to describe the actual narrow condition.
   Recommend (ii) — keeps existing semantics, less risk of cascading change.

Plus one should-fix:
(d) Finding 18 — add 'private = true' to spike/Project.toml per CLAUDE.md file map.

Do NOT change anything else. Do NOT touch the smoke-test approach, Base.== override, deepcopy choice, or the Q2.4 halt-discard logic — reviewer ACCEPTED those.
